stories.new_takeaway: Fast public clarification matters because the original location description can cause a community-safety incident to be misread as a targeted attack.
stories.why_now: Police clarification and identification reporting followed the October 19 response.
stories.previous_coverage: Not covered in the compared seven episodes.
stories.uncertainty: Investigators had not established a motive or identified all involved people at cutoff.
stories.watch: Columbus police findings on motive, suspects and any safety guidance for the affected area.
